assets.note: Stats computed over a 1000m buffer around the asset's reference point -- a coarse proxy for the real canonical polygon (not yet clipped to the exact polygon geometry in this pass).

chmv2.note: Meta/WRI Canopy Height Model v2 -- CANOPY-SURFACE height structural evidence, NOT ground truth and NOT individual-tree height (cannot separate adjacent crowns in closed canopy).

gedi.note: Real spaceborne lidar footprints (~25m circular samples), not a census. rh98 = relative height at 98th percentile of returned energy (canopy top proxy); cover/pai/fhd_normal are structural cover/leaf-area/foliage-height-diversity indices. sensitivity flags footprint quality; low-sensitivity footprints are less reliable and not filtered out here (see note).
